components.content:
## Critical Point and Triple Point

**Critical Point:** 405.56 K = 132.41 °C = 270.34 °F
- Critical Pressure: 112.08 atm = 113.41 bar = 11.357 MPa = 1647.2 psi

**Triple Point:** 195.5 K = -77.65 °C = -107.77 °F
- Triple Point Pressure: 0.0601 atm = 0.0609 bar = 6090 Pa = 0.8832 psi

At the critical point, phase boundaries vanish and liquid and vapor can no longer be distinguished. Below the triple point, ammonia exists as a solid under equilibrium conditions.
